name: DescribeSuspEvents

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request
parameters.help_zh: 访问源的IP地址
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the alert event is handled. Valid values:

N: unhandled
Y: handled
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的告警事件是否已处理。取值：
N：待处理
Y：已处理
parameters.name: dealed

parameters.help_en: The name of the asset that is affected by the alert event
parameters.help_zh: 受该告警事件影响的资产的名称
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The severity of the alert event. Separate multiple severities with commas (,). Valid values:

serious
suspicious
remind
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的告警事件处理的紧急程度，多个紧急程度之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔，紧急程度依次递减。取值：
serious：紧急
suspicious：可疑
remind：提醒
parameters.name: levels

parameters.help_en:
The alert type of the alert event. Valid values:

Suspicious process
Webshell
Unusual logon
Exception
Sensitive file tampering
Malicious process (cloud threat detection)
Suspicious network connection
Suspicious account
Application intrusion event
Cloud threat detection
Precise defense
Application whitelist
Persistent webshell
Web application threat detection
Malicious script
Threat intelligence
Malicious network activity
Cluster exception
Webshell (on-premises threat detection)
Vulnerability exploitation
Malicious process (on-premises threat detection)
Trusted exception
Others
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的告警事件的告警类型。取值：

进程异常行为
网站后门
异常登录
异常事件
敏感文件篡改
恶意进程（云查杀）
异常网络连接
异常账号
应用入侵事件
云产品威胁检测
精准防御
应用白名单
持久化后门
Web应用威胁检测
恶意脚本
威胁情报
恶意网络行为
容器集群异常
网站后门（本地查杀）
漏洞利用
恶意进程（本地查杀）
可信异常
其他
parameters.name: parent_event_types

parameters.help_en: The subtype of the alert event. Separate multiple subtypes with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 告警事件的子类型。多个类型之间使用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: event_names

parameters.help_en:
The name of the alert or the information about the asset.

Fuzzy search is supported. The asset information includes the name, public IP address, and private IP address of an asset
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的告警名称或资产的信息。

支持模糊查询。资产信息包含资产名称、公网IP、内网IP
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en:
The status of the alert event. Valid values:

0: all
1: pending handling
2: ignored
4: confirmed
8: marked as a false positive
16: handling
32: handled
64: expired
128: deleted
512: automatically blocking
513: automatically blocked
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的告警事件状态。取值：
0：全部
1：待处理
2：已忽略
4：已确认
8：已标记为误报
16：处理中
32：处理完毕
64：已经过期
128：已经删除
512：自动拦截中
513：自动拦截完毕
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 设置分页查询时，每页显示的告警事件的数量。默认值为20，表示每页显示20条告警事件。最大值为100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型。默认值为zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the alert event.

To query the details of an alert event, you must specify the ID of the alert event. You can call the [DescribeSuspEvents](~~DescribeSuspEvents~~) operation to query the IDs of alert events
parameters.help_zh:
告警事件的唯一标识ID。

如果查询单个告警事件的异常事件信息，需要提供告警事件的唯一标识ID，该ID可调用[DescribeSuspEvents](~~DescribeSuspEvents~~)接口获取
parameters.name: alarm_unique_info

parameters.help_en: The unique key of the alert
parameters.help_zh: 安全告警的唯一key
parameters.name: unique_info

parameters.help_en: The ID of the alert event
parameters.help_zh: 记录告警事件的唯一标识ID
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The data source of the alert event. Set the value to sas
parameters.help_zh: 告警事件所属数据源标识，固定为sas
parameters.name: from

parameters.help_en: The source of the alert
parameters.help_zh: 告警来源
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en: The ID of the asset group to which the affected asset belongs
parameters.help_zh: 受告警事件影响的资产的分组ID
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The UUID of the server on which the alert is detected. Separate multiple UUIDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 要查询告警的服务器的UUID，多个UUID使用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: uuids

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cluster of whose alert events you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询告警事件的集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The key of the condition that is used to query alert events on containers. Valid values:

instanceId: the ID of the asset
appName: the name of the application
clusterId: the ID of the cluster
regionId: the ID of the region
nodeName: the name of the node
namespace: the namespace
clusterName: the name of the cluster
image: the name of the image
imageRepoName: the name of the image repository
imageRepoNamespace: the namespace to which the image repository belongs
imageRepoTag: the tag that is added to the image
imageDigest: the digest of the image
parameters.help_zh:
容器检索项。取值：

instanceId：实例ID
appName：应用名
clusterId：集群ID
regionId：地域
nodeName：节点名
namespace：命名空间
clusterName：集群名称
image：镜像名称
imageRepoName：镜像的仓库名称
imageRepoNamespace：镜像的仓库命名空间
imageRepoTag：镜像的标签
imageDigest：镜像摘要
parameters.name: container_field_name

parameters.help_en: The value of the condition that is used to query alert events on containers
parameters.help_zh: 容器检索项对应值
parameters.name: container_field_value

parameters.help_en:
The item that is used to search for the container. Valid values:

containerId: the ID of the container
uuid: the UUID of the server
imageUuid: the UUID of the image
parameters.help_zh:
容器检索目标类型。取值：
containerId：容器ID
uuid：服务器UUID
imageUuid：镜像UUID
parameters.name: target_type

parameters.help_en: The tactic ID of ATT\&CK
parameters.help_zh: ATT&CK的战术ID
parameters.name: tactic_id

parameters.help_en: An array that consists of the handling result codes of alert events
parameters.help_zh: 告警事件处理结果码集合
parameters.name: operate_error_code_list

parameters.help_en: The timestamp when the handling operation starts
parameters.help_zh: 处理时间开始时间戳
parameters.name: operate_time_start

parameters.help_en: The timestamp when the handling operation ends
parameters.help_zh: 处理时间结束时间戳
parameters.name: operate_time_end

parameters.help_en: The start time when the alert event was last detected
parameters.help_zh: 最新发生时间起始时间
parameters.name: time_start

parameters.help_en: The end time when the alert event was last detected
parameters.help_zh: 最新发生时间结束时间
parameters.name: time_end

parameters.help_en:
The custom sorting field. Default value: operateTime. Valid values:

lastTime: the latest occurrence time.
operateTime: the handling time.

This parameter takes effect if you set the Dealed parameter to Y
parameters.help_zh:
自定义排序字段，默认operateTime，取值：

lastTime：最新发生时间。
operateTime：处理时间。

该字段作用于Dealed为Y
parameters.name: sort_column

parameters.help_en:
The custom sorting order. Default value: desc. Valid values:

asc: the ascending order
desc: the descending order

This parameter takes effect if you set the Dealed parameter to Y
parameters.help_zh:
自定义排序类型，默认desc，取值：

asc：升序。
desc：倒叙。

该字段作用于Dealed为Y
parameters.name: sort_type

parameters.help_en: The types of the assets
parameters.help_zh: 资产类型集合
parameters.name: assets_type_list

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the member in the resource directory.

You can call the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to query the ID
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号主账号ID。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the strict alerting mode.

N: no
Y: Yes
parameters.help_zh:
是否属于严格模式告警标识。
N：否
Y：是
parameters.name: strict_mode

parameters.help_en:
The type of the accounts that you want to query. Default value: 0. Valid values:

0: the current account.
1: all accounts
parameters.help_zh:
多账号查询类型。默认值为0。取值：
0：查询当前账号数据
1：查询所有账号数据
parameters.name: multi_account_action_type

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the Alibaba Cloud accounts within which alerts are generated
parameters.help_zh: 产生告警的阿里云账号ID列表
parameters.name: source_ali_uids

parameters.help_en: List of supported alarm operation types
parameters.help_zh: 告警支持的操作类型列表
parameters.name: support_operate_code_list
